faults.quote: Here's an exhibit: Roasted chickpea snacks — Economics of one bag and first-year launch costs.
faults.why: The candidate asked only for chip cost of goods and gross-margin history. Exhibit-1 was put up against that ask, though it is the next data in sequence.

faults.quote: I can share the survey on shopper purchase intent and planning assumptions if you'd like.
faults.why: The candidate had not asked for survey or planning data; the interviewer offered gated data unprompted.

faults.quote: An exhibit for you — Proposal — In-store sampling program (first year of the launch). How do you read this exhibit?
faults.why: At t19 the candidate said they wanted chip contribution per bag. The case holds no such figure, but no refusal was given; the ask got no word at all.

faults.quote: How would you guard against that?
faults.why: At t25 the candidate had just given mitigations: lock retailer commitments before the line spend, and stage marketing against a 12-week velocity read. The follow-up re-asks what was already answered.
